description: Defines the SharedTempStore class for managing temporary, owner-specific key/value data in Drupal, including methods for get, set, delete, and owner verification, with lock handling and session management.

classes.name: SharedTempStore
classes.description: Manages temporary owner-specific key/value data with locking and expiration, used for autosave, multi-step forms, or in-progress configuration in Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SharedTempStore with storage, lock backend, owner, request stack, current user, and expiration time.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves data for a given key.

methods.name: getIfOwner
methods.description: Retrieves data only if owned by the current owner.

methods.name: setIfNotExists
methods.description: Stores data if the key does not already exist.

methods.name: setIfOwner
methods.description: Stores data only if owned by the current owner or if the key does not exist.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores data for a key with lock handling.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns owner and update time metadata for a key.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes data for a key with lock handling.

methods.name: deleteIfOwner
methods.description: Deletes data only if owned by the current owner.

methods.name: ensureAnonymousSession
methods.description: Stores owner info in session if user is anonymous.
